description: Get a multi-day weather forecast for any location worldwide. Returns daily high/low temperatures, conditions, precipitation probability, wind speed, UV index, sunrise and sunset. Use this for 'what's the forecast this week?', 'will it rain tomorrow?', 'weekend weather', 'should I plan outdoor activities?', '7-day forecast for Dallas', or any future weather question. Supports 1-16 day forecasts.

location.description: City, zip code, or place name
